title: Structural probe of the arena decode ranges
principle: every number here comes from tasks.py / eran_agent.py / pong_env.py mechanics. No run accuracy is read.

rule.note: elig is cleared only by reset_episode(); a rule EPISODE is all 6 blocks, so traces cross every silent switch.

dms.note: reset_episode() clears elig, so a tau longer than the episode cannot leak into the next trial; it only means 'every step of THIS episode is credited', which is what a single terminal reward requires.

pong.note: the paddle moves that decide a hit happen while the ball crosses the field; credit shorter than that cannot reach them.

eps_floor_vs_criterion._note: success in bimodal.py is mean trials-to-criterion < 20. The rule rows are a BEST CASE: perfect greedy knowledge, only eps-noise. Where the best case already fails, the region is unusable regardless of learning.

strictness._note: k_at_which_spawn_dies is the effective strictness k where mean - k*sd falls below the lowest cosine the task can produce. Above it the organism can never spawn again, whatever it sees. Compare with k_reachable_now.adult.

degenerate_regions.sampling: theta ~ N(0,1)^10, the ES init distribution
degenerate_regions.note_eps0: where eps0 < eps_floor the eps schedule clamps on step 1 and eps0 has NO effect: a dead search dimension.
degenerate_regions.note_prior: median_at_theta_zero is where EVERY ES search STARTS. A re-parameterisation moves this as well as the ceiling -- the two effects are not separable by a rescale-style variant.

margin._note: margin = mean cosine(same class) - mean cosine(different class), on the L2-normalised key the organism actually matches on. margin -> 0 means the prototype memory is physically unable to separate the classes the task scores, whatever it learns.

rule_tradeoff._note: RuleSwitchTask needs BOTH margins positive at once: a key that cannot separate cards cannot act, and a key that cannot separate rules cannot switch. ctx_gain trades one against the other, so the structurally defensible band is where the weaker margin is largest -- a bound derived from the task, with no run accuracy consulted.

rule_tradeoff_competent._note: RuleSwitchTask needs BOTH margins positive at once: a key that cannot separate cards cannot act, and a key that cannot separate rules cannot switch. ctx_gain trades one against the other, so the structurally defensible band is where the weaker margin is largest -- a bound derived from the task, with no run accuracy consulted.

key_drift._note: cos between keys for the SAME card seen in the first 20 trials vs the last 40 of the SAME episode. 1.0 = the key is stationary and one prototype serves the whole episode; well below 1.0 = the context is still ramping and the organism must re-spawn the same card as if it were new.

switch_recovery._note: trials_to_recover_addressing is how long after a silent rule flip the organism keeps looking up a displaced prototype for the same card. Compare with CRIT_WINDOW=10: a displacement that outlasts the window means the block cannot be re-learned before the next flip.
